The commented-out COPY statements suggest this is testing parser/preprocessor behavior for COPY REPLACING edge cases.

verdict.notes: The file is missing a proper IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header; PROGRAM-ID appears after a COPY statement. High comment ratio (48%) due to copyright header and commented-out COPY variants. This appears to be a test fixture for the Broadcom COBOL Language Support for Eclipse/VS Code, testing COPY REPLACING preprocessing. The payroll-like names (PAYROLL1, PAY-CODE, GROSS-PAY, HOURS) are likely just placeholder identifiers for the test.
